nonblocking_recommendations.observation: NativeGraphStore.read/replay also execute loom/tools/structure/agentic_graph_v1/packet.py, which is not included in the dirty-scope/source-hash manifest. B2 native provenance checks selected graph_packet C++ units against a B build, not full dependency/header equivalence or a full B2 rebuild. The report already states the latter limitation.
nonblocking_recommendations.recommendation: Include imported packet codec in the next source manifest/dirty check and retain the selected-unit-only qualification. A wider native claim needs corresponding build/dependency provenance.

nonblocking_recommendations.observation: Node intercepts the final HTTP call and common socket entrypoints. Python socket patches do not provide a process-wide C++ network sandbox. Actual C ABI operations here are graph-store only with start_workers:false.
nonblocking_recommendations.recommendation: Keep zero external/model-call statements scoped to the executed graph-store/workflow path. Do not present these patches as a general network confinement guarantee for arbitrary native runtime operations.
